claim: After merging a lockstep PT and orama hygiene pair, post the full session closeout and graduated lesson table as a PR comment on the merged PT PR rather than rewriting the PR body under strict body-guard mode.

decisions.notes: PR body edits are blocked on open/merged hygiene PRs; comments preserve the record.
